superconducting_transmon.name: Superconducting Transmon QPU
superconducting_transmon.t2_note: T2 ≤ 2·T1 by fundamental bound; T2 echo typically 150–300 µs

cryo_cooling_power.note: Bluefors XLD400 dilution refrigerator; cooling power at each stage — loading above these limits causes thermal quench

citations: Arute et al., 'Quantum supremacy using a programmable superconducting processor', Nature 574, 505–510 (2019)
IBM Quantum Development Roadmap (2023–2026) — Heron/Condor specifications

silicon_photonic_soi.name: Silicon Photonic QPU (SOI)
silicon_photonic_soi.qubit_type: dual-rail or path-encoded photonic qubit at 1550 nm C-band
silicon_photonic_soi.cryo_requirement: SNSPD requires cryogenic operation (typically 0.8–2 K on a separate cryostat stage)
citations: Reddy et al., 'Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors', APL Photonics 8, 051101 (2023)

neutral_atom_rubidium87.name: Neutral-Atom Array (87Rb)
neutral_atom_rubidium87.qubit_type: 87Rb neutral atom in optical tweezer (ground-state hyperfine qubit)
citations: Ebadi et al., 'Quantum optimization of maximum independent set using Rydberg atom arrays', Nature 612, 71–77 (2023)

trapped_ion_ytterbium171.name: Trapped-Ion QPU (171Yb+)
citations: Quantinuum H2 specifications — 56 qubits, 99.9% 2Q gate fidelity (2024)

equations: Lindblad master equation: dρ/dt = −i[H,ρ]/ħ + Σ_k γ_k (L_k ρ L_k† − ½{L_k†L_k, ρ}) — open-system dynamics with decoherence rates γ_k
Gate error (average): E = 1 − F_avg where F_avg = (|tr(U†U_ideal)|² + d) / (d + 1)
Rydberg blockade: V(r) = C₆/r⁶; blockade radius r_b = (C₆/Ω)^(1/6) where Ω is the Rabi frequency
Blackbody decoherence rate: Γ_bb = (k_B·T/ħ)² · (2·π·c/(ω₀))² · (1/4π) — thermal photon-induced transitions
Dilution fridge cooling power: Q_cool(T) = Q_ideal(T) · η, Q_ideal(T) ∝ (T/T_c)² for dilution stage

photonic.note: SNSPD cryogenic; waveguide can be room temperature

cryo_quench.condition: Q_load > Q_cooling_capacity at any dilution fridge stage
cryo_quench.effect: temperature rises above superconducting transition → decoherence collapse, qubit loss, hours of recovery time
cryo_quench.note: Exceeding the 15 mK cooling power budget (typically 12 mW for Bluefors XLD400) causes thermal quench

magnetic_field_intrusion.condition: B > B_c for superconducting materials (Nb: B_c ≈ 200 mT)

vacuum_loss.condition: pressure > 1e-9 torr for neutral atoms / trapped ions
vacuum_loss.effect: collision-induced atom/ion loss, heating rate spikes
